positions.name: Sprint4OutcomeAttribution
positions.frame: what did Sprint 4 deliver and what drove the outcome?
positions.why: All three expressions are Tanya's retrospective reporting of Sprint 4 outcomes — what shipped (src-1), how it measured (src-2), and what enabled it (src-3). They share the same stance (accomplishment as settled fact), temporal mode (past realis), and conviction (claim). The set holds a causal arc from delivery through measurement to attribution, all performed in the same informational register; src-3's technical register and market-pricing relational form introduces a slight tension with src-1's communal-sharing 'we,' but the frame's read holds both sides — the team shipped together, and a specific integration unlocked the velocity.
